graders.name: renamed
graders.criteria: MAX_UPLOAD_MB is renamed to UPLOAD_LIMIT_MB in the config key, the environment variable that src/config.js reads, .env.example, the README table and the error message, and the service still reads the limit from the renamed key and variable. The JavaScript property name `maxUploadMb` may stay or change. Keeping MAX_UPLOAD_MB as a fallback for deployed environments passes.

graders.name: just-did-it
graders.criteria: The agent made the rename in this run. Fail if it stopped before renaming to ask for confirmation or for approval of a plan. Stating what it will rename, or a short plan it then carries out, passes.

graders.name: deploy-env-flagged
graders.criteria: The final message points out that any deployed environment setting MAX_UPLOAD_MB must now set UPLOAD_LIMIT_MB instead (or the limit falls back to the default), or says it kept the old variable as a fallback.

graders.name: small-report
graders.criteria: The final message is a short report of the rename: the files changed and any caveat that matters, such as the deployed environment variable. Fail if it adds unrequested sections or offers of unrelated follow-ups, such as refactoring the config loader or adding validation.
graders.preference: A longer report or an offer of follow-ups costs a little reading but loses nothing

graders.name: scope-files
graders.description: Only the files that name the setting change.
